title: Repair Logistics site-map builder launch
goal: Make authenticated event/tour-scoped site-map creation reliably open the builder under the selected acting organization.

in: Admin Logistics and event entry points that read or mutate site maps
Acting-organization request propagation for JSON and multipart operations
Create-response-to-builder state handoff and event/tour scope changes
Authorized site-map collection writes for organization owners
Canonical Admin Maps deep links and focused regression coverage
out: Venue, artist, public, and Work Mode site-map surfaces
Unrelated Logistics or Admin dashboard changes

acceptance_criteria: Admin site-map reads and mutations carry the explicitly selected acting organization.
A successful create response mounts the full-screen builder without depending on a list refresh.
Stale list, detail, or scope responses cannot close or reopen a map under the wrong event or tour.
Organization-owner creation writes only after server-side organization and event/tour scope validation.
Failures are shown inside the wizard and never leave an indefinite opening overlay.
Canonical links use tab=maps and retain eventId, tourId, and optional siteMapId.
Focused component, route, scope, authorization, contract, lint, and control-plane checks pass.

evidence: Focused Vitest verification passed: 8 files, 54 tests, including successful owner creation, stale-list survival, event/tour/combined scopes, multipart upload headers, denied creation, missing acting organization, deep links, and scope-change cleanup.
Focused ESLint completed with no findings across all touched implementation and test files.
Admin route registry check passed: 291 route files, 54/54 legacy classifications, exact route-method contracts, no legacy debt growth.
Isolated browser health check loaded the local app with content and no Next.js error overlay; the isolated session redirected to login, so an authenticated create could not be repeated there.
npm run verify:fast -- --changed is blocked before lint by unrelated dirty-tree deletion app/venue/components/booking-calendar.tsx.
Full npm run typecheck reports the repository's existing broad TypeScript debt; no focused lint or test failure points to this repair.

progress.summary: Repaired site-map creation and builder launch end to end: acting-organization requests cover Admin map clients, create response mounts editor independently of stale list/detail results, scope changes clear stale selection/deep links, and verified organization-owner writes use the resolved scope service client after capability and parent validation. Focused Vitest passed 54/54, focused ESLint and route registry passed, and agents:validate passed with 0 errors.
completed: Routed Admin site-map clients and editor operations through the acting-organization request adapter while preserving JSON and multipart request behavior.
Made the successful POST result authoritative for immediate builder mounting and protected it from stale list/detail responses.
Cleared selected map, pending launch, create dialog, and stale deep links when organization/event/tour scope changes.
Canonicalized Admin site-map links to tab=maps while preserving eventId/tourId/siteMapId.
Changed the verified collection route to use the resolved scope service client after explicit capability and organization/event/tour validation, fixing organization-owner RLS insertion failures.
Added an inline wizard error so server failures are visible above the Create & open builder action.
Added behavioral and route tests covering the reported path and regressions.
next_steps: Have the user refresh the authenticated Logistics page and retry Create & open builder; any remaining API failure is now displayed inline in the wizard with actionable details.
